# JobsDFY - AI-Powered Job Clarity

## Mission
A high-precision career acceleration tool designed to detect job dealbreakers (visa, salary, location) and map candidate character.

## Key Sections
- Intellectual Foundation: Academic and business framework tracking.
- Thought Leadership: Industry contribution and social strategy.
- Character Insights: Soft-skill mapping via media consumption.
- Fit Scoring: 94% accurate match analysis.

## Technical Authority
Built with Vite 8. Uses structured data for JobPosting and Person entities.
